limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by an agent that did not write or source-review the guide; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Run on the shared work lab (openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-work), which other DOC-032 agents used at the same time. Only records named DOC-032 contracts V-C16 were created. The fixture Contract type and Approver groups were archived after the run; the Contracts stay as named records.

API sessions created prerequisites (fixture type, groups, setup Contracts, a primary PDF), played the second actor's writes (including Priya Raman's rejection before the signing check), and read back saved state and refusals. Every guide step ran in the browser as the named role. See walkthrough.json.
The Business User was Lena Vogel rather than Jonas Weber, as in DOC-030, to stay clear of the shared sign-in link budget. She signed in to the Portal with a fresh magic link from the lab Mailpit.
Apply group always appeared because the lab has live groups. Its absence with no live group and no default group was not tested.

The organization setting 'Who can override a default approver group?' was set to Administrators only through the Administrator's API session for about a second per role and put back at once (walkthrough.json orgSettings).
Approval emails and email preferences were not checked. Archiving a Contract to remove a Business approver's review page was not checked.

The Signatures paragraph was observed with the e2e signing stand-in (e2e/tests/docusign.ts), not a real DocuSign account, on the owned lab c16sign. Only the direct send was checked; the prepared (embedded) send is off by default and was not run. The send dialog also asked a required question the guides do not name, 'Will the agreement be fully signed when this DocuSign round is complete?'; the walk chose 'Yes, all required signatures will be in place'. That dialog belongs to electronic-signing.md, not this guide.

The author's productBugs entry stands as observed: the send moved Awaiting approval to Out for signature with a Rejected and a Pending approval, opened no Move past approval, and History recorded only the Status change and the send, with no override entry. The guide describes this behavior; whether the Soft gate should apply is a product decision (CTR-012).
